newsitem.title: USA: Georgia-Pacific says Martell sale is one deal.
newsitem.headline: Georgia-Pacific says Martell sale is one deal.

text.p: Georgia-Pacific Corp said on Thursday its $320 million sale of timberlands, a sawmill and a particleboard plant in Martell, Calif., was not connected with efforts to reduce costs and boost efficiency.

"This is just one sale, unto itself," said spokesman Ken Haldin. "The offer was significant enough that we believed it was in our best interests and in our shareholders' best interests to proceed with the sale."
The sale to Sierra Pacific Holding Co by the Atlanta-based company's Georgia-Pacific West Inc subsidiary was expected to close in the second quarter of next year.
